description:
Structure prediction using Protenix v1 (AF3-class, 368M params). Use this skill when: (1) Predicting protein or complex structure from sequence, (2) Validating designed binders by refolding, (3) Generating confidence metrics (ipTM, pTM, pLDDT), (4) Multi-seed ensemble validation, (5) Predicting protein-ligand complexes.
For design generation, use proteus-prot or boltzgen instead. For scoring existing predictions, use by-scoring. For full pipeline orchestration, use by-design-workflow.
